Slop Inventory · free, in your browser

A free Sortly alternative for stock tracking

If you want to track stock without an online account, Slop Inventory runs in your browser and keeps products, stock and movements on this device.

Try Slop Inventory

How to do it

  1. Add products with Add product, or import a CSV in the Data tab.
  2. Receive stock at each location; transfer between locations as it moves.
  3. Scan barcodes with a USB or Bluetooth scanner, or the camera where supported.
  4. Run counts, watch low stock and reorder through Slop Purchases.

It is built for a small business selling products: orders in Slop Orders take stock out when fulfilled, and purchase orders put it back in when received. It has no photos per item, no custom fields and no sharing between people.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Inventory runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Slop Inventory made by Sortly?

No. Slopographic is not affiliated with Sortly. Sortly is a trademark of its owner, and the name is used here only to describe what people search for.

Can several people use it?

Not together. The data is kept in one browser on one device. A full backup file moves it to another computer.

Can I get my data out?

Yes. Export the product list as CSV at any time, or download a full backup of every record.

More with Slop Inventory

  • A free alternative to an inventory spreadsheet
  • Scan barcodes into your inventory
  • Do a stock count (stocktake)
